src/metrics/zones.rs.description: CadenceZones has get_zone(rpm: u8) -> u8, get_zone_range(zone: u8) -> Option<&CadenceZoneRange>, and all_zones() -> Vec<&CadenceZoneRange> methods following PowerZones/HRZones patterns. Zone lookup uses max_rpm boundaries: Z1 (0-75), Z2 (76-85), Z3 (86-95), Z4 (96-105), Z5 (106+).
